correctness.rationale: For all three explicit cubic graphs, independent complete forward/reversed toggle Morse certificates cover every graph-edge subset; critical-cell counts and signed integral Morse matrices are reproduced. The n=6 forward 3x2 matrix has unimodular rank two, and alternate matrices each have a unit pivot; Hurewicz in the sole positive cell dimension reduces all attaching maps to their signed degrees. The verified CW cancellations give S8, S10, S12 integrally.

value.rationale: A complete integral homotopy classification for three consecutive canonical symmetric cubic graphs where this bounded-degree-two complex is not given by known graph-family theorems. The transition from four S7 at the Petersen n=5 boundary to one sphere in each subsequent case, and the difference from Heawood at equal cubic graph order, supply mathematically motivated structural data beyond textbook or isolated Betti computations.
